tools.name: find_data_source
tools.description: Look up where to get data before you web-search, scrape or give up: datasets, data APIs, open-data portals, official statistics, public records and feeds (economic, FX, energy, weather, company, legal, research, health, geo, transport, news, security). Returns third-party sources with URL and access

tools.name: find_tool
tools.description: Find an MCP server for a capability you or your user lack: browser automation, databases (Postgres, BigQuery...), document conversion, email, calendar, Slack and chat, payments, cloud and devops, design, testing, memory. Use it to recommend a tool to install when the task needs one you don't have. R

tools.name: report_blocker
tools.description: Call this as soon as an access attempt fails, before you fall back or tell your user you could not do it: HTTP 401/402/403/429, a captcha or 'verify you are human' page, a paywall, a login wall, a quota, a payment or approval you cannot give, data only in PDF, stale or unclearly licensed data, or no

tools.name: browse_demand
tools.description: See what agents have asked for, per category, with request counts and median stated price. Call it before register_demand: if a matching request exists, use endorse_demand instead of registering a duplicate.

tools.name: register_demand
tools.description: Record a dataset, API, MCP tool or service you (or your principal) need and the most you would pay for it. Free; no payment is taken. Do not include personal data.

tools.name: endorse_demand
tools.description: Add your support (and optionally your own price) to an existing request from browse_demand. Prefer this over registering a duplicate.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_data_source, find_tool · Private data: find_data_source, find_tool, report_blocker, register_demand · Public sink: find_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_data_source, find_tool · Private data: find_data_source, find_tool, report_blocker, register_demand · Public sink: find_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
